name: The Pile Keeper
description: a huge old imp who keeps a pile of everything that fell into Hell: a big hunched crimson imp with scarred skin, broken horns, ragged bat wings, a cracked iron helmet, sitting on top of a heaped pile of junk: diamonds, a cart wheel, a broken spear, a bent halo, sacks and shoes, clutching a long bent spear

poses.stand: sitting hunched on top of his heaped pile of junk and diamonds, the bent spear held upright, glaring
poses.struck: jolted on his pile, eyes bulging, a few diamonds and a shoe tumbling off it
poses.dead: the pile collapsing in an avalanche of junk and diamonds as he tumbles off it

idle.action: sits on his pile, clutching it possessively, glaring and grumbling

attack.action: rears up on his pile and hurls the bent spear forward to the right, then grabs another out of the pile

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
